authorization_scope: One bounded 2.5x legacy-clamp/snapshot cell matched to the already completed 2.5x physical E0 reference; no full E1 sweep and no E2 placement comparison.

research_basis.authoritative_definition: docs/evaluation/TrafficTwin_research_audit_reply_2026-08-07.md defines legacy as clamp/snapshot and physical as sequential rejection/conservation at 0.75x, 2.5x and 40x.
research_basis.bounded_unit: The 2.5x point is selected first because the predeclared E0 full reference already supplies the exact physical arm. Only the missing legacy arm requires new full execution.
research_basis.hypothesis: Legacy clamp may hide work loss and may change penalty-inclusive offered-task latency relative to physical rejection. No directional result is assumed.
not_answered_by_this_pair: the effect of changing the waiting-room ceiling

vec_env.selection_reason: Audited remote-main commit already used for E0; its clean pinned worktree preserves the unrelated original checkout and supplies both documented E1 semantic paths.

cap.name: per-RSU admission/in-flight task ceiling
cap.source: The audited evaluator defines the 50/20 ratio as training parity; the research audit includes 2.5x as the middle E1 pilot point.

legacy.source_semantics: Tasks beyond the aggregate per-RSU ceiling remain scored as served candidates while only the admitted fraction of batch work enters the backlog.

environment.sumo_execution_note: The evaluator replays the NPZ and does not invoke SUMO. This is a compatibility smoke/reference, not an exact canonical SUMO 1.27.0 reproduction.

common_assertions: summary offered equals total tasks, per-step arrivals and active per-task records
per-step deadline-met equals active per-task met flags
Local + V2I + V2V offered-action counts equal offered tasks
all recorded numerical values are finite
counts, queue depths, work and latency values that cannot be negative are nonnegative
deadline attainment is not labelled confirmed physical completion or result return
legacy_specific: the two 10-step smoke runs must have identical scientific summaries and instrumentation array identities before the full legacy run
n_admitted, completion_admitted, avg_latency_admitted_ms, avg_latency_met_ms and work_ms must be null as documented by the snapshot path
task_outcome must be absent as documented by the snapshot path
legacy zero-valued rejection counters must not be interpreted as observed zero rejection
legacy task/work conservation is reported as unavailable and violated by construction, not passed
physical_specific: the reused E0 validation decision remains full_corrected_reference_pass
offered equals admitted plus six terminal rejection/unavailability reasons
V2I and vehicle work ledgers conserve milliseconds of service work
paired_assertions: trace, actor, cap, evaluator seed, fleet seed, placement, scaling and compute multiplier match
per-task active masks and task types match exactly across semantic arms
paired metrics are calculated by validation code, not by an LLM
no admitted-task or rejection delta is calculated when the legacy denominator is unavailable

metric_denominators.legacy_rejection_fraction: unavailable; clamp has no per-task rejection outcomes

stop_conditions: either legacy smoke fails common instrumentation reconciliation
the two legacy smokes differ scientifically under the deterministic runtime contract
input identity or predeclared configuration differs
the full legacy run emits NaN, infinity, impossible negative values or silent task-record loss
the physical E0 evidence no longer matches its retained checksums
limitations: This is one seed pair at one cap and is not the complete E1 waiting-room sweep.
Legacy clamp is a superseded non-work-conserving software path, not a physical system.
Legacy admitted, rejected and work-loss magnitudes are not emitted by the pinned evaluator and will remain explicitly unavailable.
The 6220-task ceiling is provisional training parity, not an approved physical buffer and not compute power.
The UK-2030 fleet preset remains provisional pending the complete historical run contract.
Installed SUMO 1.27.1 differs from trace provenance 1.27.0.
No native physical completion or result-return events are observed.
One pair cannot support an uncertainty interval or a general causal claim.
